lines.text: Where's your glow from? Most light on your face goes inside you.
lines.phonemes: wˌeəz jɔː ɡlˈəʊ fɹɒm? mˈəʊst lˈaɪt ˌɒn jɔː fˈeɪs ɡəʊz ɪnsˈaɪd juː.

lines.text: Only a few percent bounces off the top as a glint. Smooth, hydrated skin sends it back in one direction; dry skin scatters it into a dull haze.
lines.phonemes: ˈəʊnli ɐ fjˈuː pəsˈɛnt bˈaʊnsɪz ˈɒf ðə tˈɒp az ɐ ɡlˈɪnt. smˈuːð, haɪdɹˈeɪtɪd skˈɪn sˈɛndz ɪt bˈak ɪn wˈɒn daɪɹˈɛkʃən; dɹˈaɪ skˈɪn skˈatəz ɪt ˌɪntʊ ɐ dˈʌl hˈeɪz.

lines.text: But the glint isn't the glow. The rest slips in, bounces among cells and fibres, and a large share finds its way back out.
lines.phonemes: bˌʌt ðə ɡlˈɪnt ˌɪzənt ðə ɡlˈəʊ. ðə ɹˈɛst slˈɪps ˈɪn, bˈaʊnsɪz ɐmˌʌŋ sˈɛlz and fˈaɪbəz, and ɐ lˈɑːdʒ ʃˈeə fˈaɪndz ɪts wˈeɪ bˈak ˈaʊt.

lines.text: You might picture a glow sitting on the skin. But it's light that travelled through you, tinted by melanin and blood, and a rush of blood sends it back redder.
lines.phonemes: juː mˌaɪt pˈɪktʃəɹ ɐ ɡlˈəʊ sˈɪtɪŋ ɒnðə skˈɪn. bˌʌt ɪts lˈaɪt ðat tɹˈavəld θɹˈuː juː, tˈɪntɪd bˈaɪ mˈɛlənɪn and blˈʌd, and ɐ ɹˈʌʃ ɒv blˈʌd sˈɛndz ɪt bˈak ɹˈɛdə.

lines.text: Asked to make strangers' faces look as healthy as they could, people turned up exactly that: the colour of blood, shining back through the skin.
lines.phonemes: ˈaskt tə mˌeɪk stɹˈeɪndʒəz fˈeɪsɪz lˈʊk az hˈɛlθi az ðeɪ kˈʊd, pˈiːpəl tˈɜːnd ˌʌp ɛɡzˈaktli ðˈat: ðə kˈʌləɹ ɒv blˈʌd, ʃˈaɪnɪŋ bˈak θɹuː ðə skˈɪn.

lines.text: Blue light gets barely a millimetre in, about ten sheets of paper; red light goes several times deeper.
lines.phonemes: blˈuː lˈaɪt ɡˈɛts bˈeəli ɐ mˈɪlɪmˌiːtəɹ ˈɪn, ɐbˌaʊt tˈɛn ʃˈiːts ɒv pˈeɪpə; ɹˈɛd lˈaɪt ɡəʊz sˈɛvɹəl tˈaɪmz dˈiːpə.

lines.text: So the glow isn't on your face. It's light that went inside you, met your blood, and came back.
lines.phonemes: sˌəʊ ðə ɡlˈəʊ ˌɪzənt ˌɒn jɔː fˈeɪs. ɪts lˈaɪt ðat wɛnt ɪnsˈaɪd juː, mˈɛt jɔː blˈʌd, and kˈeɪm bˈak.

lines.text: Next: skin closes almost any cut. But is a scar still skin?
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: skˈɪn klˈəʊzɪz ˈɔːlməʊst ˌɛni kˈʌt. bˌʌt ɪz ɐ skˈɑː stˈɪl skˈɪn?
